title: FLUX.1-schnell: inpainting with a latent noise mask
description: Repaints the masked area of a source image from the prompt with FLUX.1-schnell from the all-in-one checkpoint. Schnell isn't a fill model (FLUX.1 Fill has a mask-conditioned input; schnell has none), so the mask works only as a latent noise mask: SetLatentNoiseMask limits sampling to the masked area (4 steps, CFG 1.0, euler, simple) and the model sees the rest only through the latent; at the default denoise 1.0 the masked area is generated anew, lower keeps more of the source there. ImageCompositeMasked puts the result over the source, so the pixels outside the mask are the source's and the output has the source image's size. The mask is a separate image in ComfyUI's input folder, white where the image is repainted, read from its red channel by LoadImageMask. The checkpoint has to be in checkpoints/ (GAPS Q13).

slots.label: Source image (file name in ComfyUI's input folder)
Mask (file name in ComfyUI's input folder; white repaints)
Denoise inside the mask (1 generates it anew)

evidence.note: The inpaint pattern: LoadImage into VAEEncode, a mask from a loader, SetLatentNoiseMask (samples, mask) into KSampler's latent. ImageCompositeMasked after the decode is this recipe's addition, after packs/z-image-turbo-inpainting, so the unmasked pixels stay the source's.
